build_hfencoder_with_roberta: build a HFEncoder using roberta-base as the pretrained transformer model for sentence encoding
build_hfencoder_with_projection: build a HFEncoder with a custom projection_dim to project embeddings to a lower dimension
run_hfencoder_forward: run the HFEncoder forward pass with tokenized input to get sentence representations
review_hfencoder_init: review the HFEncoder init to understand dropout and projection_dim configuration options
test_hfencoder_sentence_encoding: test the HFEncoder forward method to verify it returns cloned sentence embeddings
